sloka: कपिवातश्च बलवान् मेघवातश्च निःसृतः ।सागरं भीमनिर्घोषं कम्पयामासतुर्भृशम् ॥५-१-७०॥
transliteration: kapivātaśca balavān meghavātaśca niḥsṛtaḥ ।sāgaraṁ bhīmanirghoṣaṁ kampayāmāsaturbhṛśam ॥5-1-70॥

translations.english: The forceful wind generated by the monkey moving swiftly, and by the clouds agitated the ocean violently, creating dreadful sounds.
